**Abstract.** An introduction to the basic ideas and methods of Chiral Perturbation Theory is presented. Several phenomenological applica- tions of the eﬀective Lagrangian technique to strong, electromagnetic and weak interactions are discussed. To be published in Reports on Progress in Physics February 1995

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Chiral symmetry; 3 Eﬀective chiral Lagrangian at lowest order; 4.2 Chiral loops; 4.3 The chiral anomaly; 5.1 Decay constants; 5.2 Electromagnetic form factors; 5.4 Meson and quark masses; 6 The role of resonances in ChPT; 7 Short-distance estimates of ChPT parameters; 8 ∆S = 1 non-leptonic weak interactions; 8.2 Radiative K Decays; 8.3 The chiral anomaly in non-leptonic K decay; 9 Baryons; 9.1 Loops; 9.2 Heavy baryon ChPT; 9.3 Non-leptonic hyperon decays
